title: rest: pin details.candidates on the cross-object batch door and the census doors, and check the candidates elements before the cast in error-response
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Follow-up of #32250 (PR #32740), from the epic red-line read 6825274386 on head `41354c38a`. Not a merge blocker (maintainer rule: only correctness, red-line or security items block). Parked under ruling 6824949405 on #31527.

## What is owed

1. The cross-object `POST /batch` door carries the `details.candidates` option unpinned (PR #32740 says NOT MEASURED). Measure and pin.
2. `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts` (the candidates read near the 409 mapping) casts the recogniser's `readonly unknown[]` without an element check. Check each element's shape, or narrow the recogniser's return type.
3. The census doors gain the member unpinned (ruling F1=A allows it). Pin one census door.

## Acceptance

Each item pinned (red before, green after) on `main` after PR #32740's merge; no answer moves.

Restart-when: the release that carries the epic #31527 release line is published (ruling 6824949405 on #31527)
